items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: And then we had a kid out of Whiteman's band, Frankie Cush, played lead. Trompett, didn't, in those days he never had no five brass, he only had three brass.

ctx.x: And you don't remember who was in Pettis's band by the chance.

Tony, like I told you, Tony Perrani. And, uh, we had a carnet jazz carnet player, a guy by the name, uh, uh, he had played with, boy he was a jig, but he, he played with all, he was white as you are. Uh, Nigga Moore was his name. He was famous for his hat, you know, the, the derby with the growling, you know. He, he was famous for that. And then we had a kid out of Whiteman's band, Frankie Cush, played lead. Trompett, didn't, in those days he never had no five brass, he only had three brass. Uh, Charlie…
About what year was that, do you remember?
